title: code-review-team finding
description: One code-review finding. Emitted as one JSON object per line in <agent>.findings.jsonl.

id.description: Stable per-run finding ID, e.g. 'correctness-reviewer-003'. Prefix with the specialist name, zero-padded index suffix.

confidence.description: certain = directly observed in code, fix is mechanical; likely = observed pattern + reasonable inference; possible = inferred from indirect evidence; unverified = cannot confirm without running code.

root_issue.description: Short slug for dedupe across specialists.

evidence.description: Exact code snippet or config excerpt, quoted verbatim.

related.description: IDs of related findings from other specialists (cross-specialist correlation).

hit_count.description: Number of distinct consensus passes this finding was seen in (see Step 3a, MIN_PASSES=2..MAX_PASSES=8). Only set for correctness-reviewer/performance-reviewer findings produced via the loop-until-dry consensus fan-out; omitted for single-pass specialists.
